result.summary: Found 1 minor styling inconsistency; overall layout appears intact.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white on a busy image background, while a similar icon on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-transparent circular background behind the heart icon on all promotional cards for better visibility and consistency.
